answer: Fake identities multiply but each one pays the same lockup plus slashing risk, so a thousand-agent swarm costs a thousand bonds. Sybil resistance here rests on staked reputation slot: each agent locks a bond in the grove registry before earning, and every attestation it casts must be backed by that stake. Reputation compounds only through verified peer attestations, turning history into a crystal ledger no clone can inherit. A fable of free accounts collapses once cost per identity exceeds any reward. In practice, Agent0088 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
